item.title: Why Metadata Enrichment Matters for the Public Knowledge Project
item.description: Through COMET, PKP wants to help put in place processes, systems, and governance that can bring together a community—of scholars, librarians, infrastructure developers, university administrators, funders, and others—to develop a shared accountability for the integrity of scholarly communication.
